data.name: Murugasan
data.gender_notes: Murugasan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who bears the mountain (Murugan) or one who is the lord of mountains (San). The name Murugasan carries the meaning “God of War and Love” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Murugasan usually hope their child will grow to embody god of war and love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine power of the universe to protect and destroy evil, and the ability to love and conquer
data.etymology: Murugasan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of War and Love.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Murugasan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: Murugasan is a name deeply rooted in Tamil culture, named after the southern Indian deity, Lord Murugan, also known as Kartikeya or Subramanyam. Lord Murugan is the god of war, healing, and mountains, and is widely worshipped in Tamil Nadu and other parts of South India. The name "Murugasan" reflects the deep reverence and devotion that the people of Tamil Nadu have towards their beloved deity.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Murugasan" carries a significant spiritual meaning, emphasizing the powerful connection between an individual and Lord Murugan. It signifies that the person carries the qualities and blessings of Lord Murugan within them. Lord Murugan is believed to bring healing, strength, and protection, making "Murugasan" an empowering name that reflects hope, courage, and devotion to the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "God of War and Love" symbolizes One who bears the mountain (Murugan) or one who is the lord of mountains (San). historical_references.reference: Murugasan is believed to be a Tamil name derived from Murugan, a god in Hindu mythology. Murugan is the god of war, love, and fertility. He is also known as Kartikeya and Subramanian. According to legend, he was born to the god Shiva and his wife Parvati to destroy the demon Surapadman.

Another reference for Murugasan is as a ruler in the medieval Chola Empire of Tamil Nadu, India. Murugasan I, the earliest known king of this name, ruled during the late 11th century CE and was a vassal of the Chola king Kulothunga Chola I.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Murugasan' is of Hindu origin, derived from the Tamil god Murugan. It is a popular name in Tamil Nadu, India, and is seen in various contexts in modern society. In the Tamil film industry, there have been several actors and characters with this name, including Murugasan in the film 'Mannar Vagaiyara' and the actor Murugadoss. In Tamil literature, Murugasan is a name found in various works, such as the poem 'Thirumurugatruppadai'. In South Indian culture, Murugasan is a name given to boys born during the month of Aadi, which is believed to be blessed by Lord Murugan. The name is also seen in various modern platforms, such as Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, and Hotstar, where Tamil content is consumed by a global audience.
